description: This file contains functions and types for managing configuration state, including loading, saving, applying configurations, and handling configuration forms in a web UI context.

methods.name: loadConfig
methods.description: Loads the current configuration snapshot from the server.

methods.name: loadConfigSchema
methods.description: Loads the configuration schema and UI hints from the server.

methods.name: applyConfigSchema
methods.description: Applies the received configuration schema and UI hints to the state.

methods.name: applyConfigSnapshot
methods.description: Updates the state with a new configuration snapshot, handling raw config and form data.

methods.name: serializeFormForSubmit
methods.description: Serializes the form data for submission, coercing types as needed.

methods.name: saveConfig
methods.description: Saves the current configuration form to the server.

methods.name: applyConfig
methods.description: Applies the current configuration form to the server.

methods.name: runUpdate
methods.description: Triggers an update process on the server.

methods.name: updateConfigFormValue
methods.description: Updates a specific value in the configuration form.

methods.name: removeConfigFormValue
methods.description: Removes a specific value from the configuration form.

methods.name: findAgentConfigEntryIndex
methods.description: Finds the index of an agent configuration entry by agent ID.

methods.name: ensureAgentConfigEntry
methods.description: Ensures an agent configuration entry exists, creating it if necessary.

methods.name: openConfigFile
methods.description: Requests to open the configuration file, or copies its path to clipboard if unavailable.
